fields.climate: varies from tropical in east to dry desert in west; temperate to frigid in Andes
fields.terrain: western coastal plain (costa), high and rugged Andes in center (sierra), eastern lowland jungle of Amazon Basin (selva)
fields.hazards: earthquakes, tsunamis, flooding, landslides, mild volcanic activity; volcanism: volcanic activity in the Andes Mountains; Ubinas (5,672 m) is the country's most active volcano…
fields.resources: copper, silver, gold, petroleum, timber, fish, iron ore, coal, phosphate, potash, hydropower, natural gas
fields.farm: sugarcane, potatoes, rice, bananas, milk, maize, chicken, oil palm fruit, cassava, grapes
fields.exports: copper ore, gold, refined copper, refined petroleum, grapes
fields.industries: mining and refining of minerals; steel, metal fabrication; petroleum extraction and refining, natural gas and natural gas liquefaction…
fields.languages: Spanish (official) 82.9%, Quechua (official) 13.6%, Aymara (official) 1.6%, Ashaninka 0.3%, other native languages (includes many minor Amazonian languages) 0.8%, other 0.2%, none 0.1%, unspecified…
fields.religions: Catholic 76%, Evangelical Christian 15.7%, no religion 5.1%, other religions 3.2%
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory until the age of 70
fields.military: 18-30 years of age for voluntary military service (12-24 months)
